stdio_mmap.description: Allows basic I/O (read, write), process lifecycle (exit, exit_group), memory management (brk), and memory mapping (mmap) but MUST deny mmap when PROT_EXEC (bit 2) is set in args[2] (the prot parameter).

allow.constraint: args[2] (prot) must not have bit 2 (PROT_EXEC) set

network_socket.description: Allows basic I/O (read, write, close), networking (connect, sendto, recvfrom), and socket creation ONLY for AF_INET (2) or AF_INET6 (10) with SOCK_STREAM (1) or SOCK_DGRAM (2). The socket type check must mask out SOCK_CLOEXEC (0x80000) and SOCK_NONBLOCK (0x800) before comparison.

allow.constraint: args[0] (domain) must be 2 (AF_INET) or 10 (AF_INET6); args[1] (type) masked with ~0x80800 must be 1 (SOCK_STREAM) or 2 (SOCK_DGRAM)

fs_readonly.description: Allows read-only filesystem access: read, close, fstat, lseek, exit, exit_group, and open ONLY when the access mode bits indicate O_RDONLY (args[1] & O_ACCMODE == 0, where O_ACCMODE = 3 and args[1] is the flags parameter).
